headline: Adaptive Biotechnologies Enters Partnership with Illumina to Develop Distributable IVD Test Kits for clonoSEQ and immunoSEQ Dx
summary:

(Nasdaq: ILMN) to develop in-vitro diagnostic (IVD) test kits for Adaptive’s current and future portfolio of next-generation sequencing (NGS)-based immunodiagnostics.
